name: Springboard
description: Bootstrap loader on the new tab page. Programs run in a sandboxed iframe and reach extension-origin capabilities through a small postMessage bridge.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals allow-downloads allow-pointer-lock; script-src * 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob: data:; style-src * 'unsafe-inline'; img-src * blob: data:; font-src * blob: data:; media-src * blob: data:; connect-src *; child-src * blob: data:; frame-src * blob: data:; worker-src * blob:; object-src 'none';
